The duration of this reduced demand at North America truck markets will largely depend on the trajectory of the broader economy, the evolution of trade and tariff policies, and the pace at which regulatory clarity emerges. Despite the challenges in the North America truck market, we have the benefit of operating a diversified global business and expect continued strength in our power generation market.
